gitCommit.subject: Ops: verify-production — suite config beside playwright.config, edge-rewrite diagnosis
gitCommit.body:
Ops: verify-production — suite config beside playwright.config, edge-rewrite diagnosis

The browser suite found no tests because a config in e2e/ resolved testDir to
e2e/e2e: it now sits beside playwright.config.ts. The sitemap check no longer
mistakes /account-deletion for /account. Edge rewriting by Cloudflare Email
Address Obfuscation is its own check, and the differences from the build are
decoded back to prove they are that rewrite and nothing else.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01WqJ1WH6TJWfctbXGjyqFZt
